idea-plugin.name: Github-san tools
idea-plugin.description:
Opens files and directories inside Git submodules, worktrees, and multi-root repositories on GitHub directly from JetBrains IDEs, automatically pushes ahead Git submodules during pushes, and launches Sanskrit-aware diffs with diff_san (local-diff-san).

In projects where multiple submodules or checkouts share the same GitHub repository URL (for example separate content and static branch submodules under a parent repo), or in unregistered submodules and repository root directories, the built-in GitHub integration hides the Open in Browser and Copy Link actions.

  • Silent Submodule Auto-Push (PrePushHandler): During IDE Git Push / Commit & Push, automatically detects unpushed commits in initialized submodules (bottom-up) and pushes them silently whenever push.recurseSubmodules is not configured on the machine (skipping detached HEAD submodules cleanly).
  • Push Submodules & Repository: Explicitly pushes unpushed submodule commits bottom-up and then pushes the enclosing repository.
  • Enable Git Submodule Auto-Push: Configures git config --global push.recurseSubmodules on-demand and optionally installs a bottom-up pre-push Git hook so native CLI pushes auto-push submodules too.
  • Open In → GitHub: Opens the file or directory in your browser (supports Project View, Editor, Editor Tab, and NavBar).
  • Copy Path/Reference → GitHub Repository URL: Copies the canonical GitHub URL (with line/selection #L... anchors from editors).
  • Diff with diff_san: Diffs a selected file/directory (or multiple files) against Git HEAD, or compares two selected files side by side with local-diff-san.
  • Submodules & Worktrees: Resolves .git pointer files, commondir, tracking branches, detached HEAD commits, and UTF-8 / Devanagari paths.
  • Zero Duplicate Clutter: Automatically hides Open/Copy GitHub actions whenever the built-in GitHub action already covers the selected file.

Prerequisites for Diff actions: Install local-diff-san (pip install local-diff-san) following the local-diff-san README (and see the diff_san overview README). The plugin automatically searches DIFF_SAN_BIN, PATH, project .venv/venv, ~/gitland/python_venv/bin, and ~/.local/bin.

Source & issue tracker: sanskrit-coders/jetbrains_san.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Added silent bottom-up submodule auto-push via com.intellij.prePushHandler when push.recurseSubmodules is not configured on the machine.
  • Added Push Submodules & Repository action to push unpushed submodule commits bottom-up and then the superproject.
  • Added Enable Git Submodule Auto-Push action to configure git config --global push.recurseSubmodules on-demand and optionally install a bottom-up pre-push hook.

1.1.1

  • Linked diff_san and local-diff-san installation instructions in the plugin description and READMEs.

1.1.0

  • Added Diff against HEAD (diff_san) / Diff Two Files (diff_san) action integrating diff_san (local-diff-san) from Project View, Editor, Editor Tabs, View → Compare Actions, and VCS Changes view.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Github-san tools.
  • Added Open In → GitHub and Copy Path/Reference → GitHub Repository URL fallback actions for Git submodules, worktrees, and directory roots.
  • Added automatic deduplication when the built-in GitHub plugin already handles the selected file.

action.description: Open the selected file or directory on GitHub (supports submodules)
Copy the GitHub URL for the selected file or directory (supports submodules)
Diff selected file(s) or directory against Git HEAD, or compare two selected files using diff_san
Push ahead commits in submodules bottom-up and then push the repository
Configure global push.recurseSubmodules=on-demand and optional repository pre-push hook
